insights.obligationUnitBasis: Interpreted as percentage values from the source scale; the CSV does not declare units.
insights.bandPurpose: Descriptive dataset groups, not lender approval rules or default probabilities.

metricDefinitions.below600: Count of finite nonnegative credit_score values strictly below 600; denominator creditScore.
metricDefinitions.withBounces: Count of finite nonnegative bounce_count values greater than zero; denominator bounceCount.
metricDefinitions.averageObligationRatio: Arithmetic mean of finite nonnegative source average_obligation_to_income_ratio values; values retained on the 0–100 percentage scale.
metricDefinitions.scoreBands: Local descriptive intervals [minimum inclusive, maximum exclusive], not a validated default or lender approval model.
metricDefinitions.obligationBands: Local descriptive percentage intervals [minimum inclusive, maximum exclusive], not approval thresholds.
metricDefinitions.serviceCosts: Observed service costs summarized by mileage_range; p90 and median use linear interpolation at (n − 1) × percentile.
metricDefinitions.missingValues: Blank, malformed, nonfinite or negative risk values excluded; per-metric denominator and missingOrInvalid count reported.

safety.scope: Source configuration rows; aggregate safety reference only.
limitations: Ratings are not warranty claim outcomes, credit scores, or default probabilities.
Unrated configurations are excluded from star percentages and averages.
Body styles and drivetrains are separate observations, not unique vehicles.
No safety rating is attached to a service vehicle without a matching make, model, and year.

lineage.currencyNote: Local CSVs do not declare currency. INR is the project display convention, not a verified conversion.
lineage.crossDatasetJoinNote: Service and credit sources have no shared borrower or policy identifiers; aggregate references stay separate.

excludedSources.reason: Different vehicle market; no declared monetary currency or borrower/policy linkage. Selling prices not treated as INR loan training targets.
AC/TV appliance warranty fraud labels cannot validate automotive warranty decisions.
AC/TV appliance records are not automotive claims and have no fraud labels.
Competition prediction template, not observed automotive outcomes.
